backcard_card_text:
[Auto][Once per turn] When your green 《Boujack Brigade》 card is played, draw 1 card.
[Auto][Once per turn] Place 3 face-up 《Boujack Brigade》 cards from your Z-Deck in your Drop : When this card attacks, switch this card to Active Mode and it gets +10000 power for the battle.
[Activate : Battle][Once per turn] If it’s your opponent’s turn and you KO 1 of your green 《Boujack Brigade》 cards : This card gets +10000 power for the battle.
card_set: ZENKAI Series EX Set 08 LEGEND OF THE DRAGON BALLS [DBS-B25]
card_text:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn] Place 1 green 《Boujack Brigade》 card from your hand face up in your Z-Deck : Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 green 《Boujack Brigade》 card to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less or you have 2 or more face-up 《Boujack Brigade》 cards in your Z-Deck : Draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
